document_scope: Exact prompt, reference-lineage, and final-file provenance. This is not the browser QA report.

origin.description: Food masters are AI-generated or AI-edited project media. They are not photographs of documented real dishes, kitchens, restaurants, or food experiments.
origin.reference_input_scope: The image reference inputs recorded below point to other project-generated outputs. External portfolio URLs are research references, not recorded production image inputs.
origin.output_id_note: Output IDs are the basenames of the supplied image_gen output paths. They are not claimed to be random seeds or model-version identifiers.

rights_and_limits: This manifest records origin and transformations; it does not grant a new image license or assert exclusive copyright ownership.
No MIT, CC0, or third-party stock license is asserted for the AI-generated food images. Software and font notices are documented separately in licenses/THIRD-PARTY.md.

Prompt phrases such as real photograph, exact geometry, 100mm macro, or percentage gloss reductions are verbatim creative instructions, not verified acquisition metadata or measured physical properties.
Reference-based AI edits can change fine details. Continuity is authored; pixel-identical geometry across generated states is not guaranteed.
Native masters are 1536 by 1024 pixels. A 4K viewport is a layout/rendering target, not a claim of native 4K image capture or generation.
The generation interface did not expose a model version or seed in the supplied records. Exact pixel regeneration from prompt text is not promised.
Unselected concept and study images are intentionally not bundled. Their prompts, output IDs, dimensions, checksums, and lineage remain as text records.
The runtime material systems are artistic effects, not calibrated heat, chemistry, viscosity, fracture, or steam simulations.

responsive_encoding_pipeline.resize_kernel: lanczos3, the Sharp default; not passed explicitly
responsive_encoding_pipeline.master_handling: Generated PNG files were copied byte-for-byte to assets/masters. No local upscaling or pixel retouching of those masters is claimed.
responsive_encoding_pipeline.alpha_handling: The pastry hero retains its real alpha channel in the PNG master and WebP exports. The observed PNG alpha range is 0–254; it was not normalized or flattened.
responsive_encoding_pipeline.encoding_scope: Two WebP delivery derivatives per master, with native aspect ratio retained. These are lossy color encodings with alphaQuality set to 100 where alpha exists.

included: software/font licenses and separate font provenance
bundle_policy.plate_exception_explained: concept-plate is the same output as the selected tart-plate master. It is counted once, and included only under its production filename.
bundle_policy.runtime_note: Motion uses the still textures and authored browser rendering. Optional audio is synthesized with WebAudio, not supplied as a recording.
